text:
Fix design issues on the Outreach screen (Personalized Email Draft):

Font consistency — All text on this screen should use the same monospaced/uppercase font as the rest of the dashboard. The creator name "Isabelle Lynn", handle, metadata labels (TO, SUBJECT, DEAL, Tone), and button text are falling back to a default system font. Apply the global dashboard font family consistently across all elements in this panel.
Label/value overlap — The field labels (TO, SUBJECT, DEAL) are overlapping or too tightly packed against their values. Fix the layout so labels and values are properly spaced — either use a consistent two-column grid (label fixed-width left, value right) or add sufficient gap/padding so nothing overlaps or collides.
Warning banner — The red "Outreach not recommended — disqualified by scoring" banner text is very small and hard to read. Increase the font size, add padding inside the banner, and ensure the warning icon and text are vertically centered and legible.
Tone selector — "WARM", "DIRECT", "BRIEF" buttons should be consistent in size, padding, and font. The active state (WARM) uses the green highlight correctly — make sure inactive states have a clear but visually distinct style (e.g. dark background, muted border).
Generate Draft button — The button appears low-contrast and flat. It should be clearly styled as a secondary action — visible border, readable label, consistent font and padding matching the rest of the UI.
Overall spacing — Add consistent internal padding to the card container so no elements touch the edges, and ensure vertical rhythm between each field row is uniform.

Fix score bar labels being clipped (AI Context Themes section):
Labels like "AUTHENTICITY" are getting cut off before the bar starts. Fix:

Set min-width: 130px + flex-shrink: 0 on the label column
Add gap: 10px between label and bar track

Don't touch the bars or score values — those are correct.

still not fixed Fix the score bars section — labels are being cut off:
In the AI Context Themes / scores section, the metric labels on the left (AUTHENTICITY, NICHE FIT, ENGAGEMENT, SENTIMENT) are being clipped — the last letter or two is cut off before the bar starts (e.g. "AUTHENTICTY" instead of "AUTHENTICITY").
Fix this by:

Give the label column a fixed minimum width (e.g. min-width: 130px or wider) so no label text gets truncated regardless of screen width
Don't let the bar track start until after the label has fully rendered — use a flex row with flex-shrink: 0 on the label so it never gets squeezed
Add a small gap (8–12px) between the end of the label and the start of the bar track so they don't butt up against each other
Ensure this fix applies consistently to all four rows (Authenticity, Niche Fit, Engagement, Sentiment)

The score values on the right (9/10, 8/10 etc.) and the bar fills are rendering correctly — do not change those.
